en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 3. Al-Husayn ibn Ibrahim ibn Ahmad al-Ma`addab (RA) said: Muhammad ibn Abu `Abd Allah al-Kufi said: Muhammad ibn Isma`il al-Barmaki said: `Ali ibn Salim said, on the authority of his father that I enquired from al-Sadiq Ja`far ibn Muhammad (AS): “O son of the Messenger of Allah! What do you say about the Qur’an?”

Hence, he responded, “It is the Word of Allah, His Speech, His Book, the Revelation He revealed. It is the Honorable Book, which falsehood shall not come to it from before it not from behind it; a revelation from the Wise, the Praised One.”
